name: 95842 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95842 (Sacramento) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 20 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 15 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95842 (Sacramento) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 95842 (Sacramento) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 52% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 29 organizations here; 28% of all organizations here have no identified type.
